title: InputPanel reads the plaintext mirror key at mount, including on a page that may not write this device's files
evidence: widget-src/src/components/InputPanel.tsx:198 calls loadFromLocalStorage() (health_roadmap_data) once at mount to pick the legacy or matrix vitals view. On a page that may not write this device's health files (US-09 AC2c) the read still happens; it only picks the view, and nothing from it is shown. Found 2026-11-13
